title: Creation: Light & Life
objective: help viewers see the biblical story clearly and explore the passage for themselves

script.hook: What if Creation: Light & Life changed everything?
script.thesis: Creation: Light & Life (Genesis 1:1–2:3) is more than an ancient account. It calls us to see God’s character, human response, and hope with fresh attention.

narration.text: Here is the story of Creation: Light & Life.
We begin with the setting, the people, and the tension that brings this moment into focus.
Walk through the key movement of the passage carefully, letting the biblical text lead the account.
Notice what this reveals about God and the faithful response the passage calls forth.
Today, we can help viewers see the biblical story clearly and explore the passage for themselves. Read the passage for yourself and continue the conversation.
